a16z-rigetti-computing:lever:0f66c1c3-12.description: As a Quantum Engineer at Rigetti Computing, you will be a key contributor to the development of our gate-based, superconducting quantum computers. a16z-with-protege:ashbyhq:6348293b-5549-.description: Company Overview: We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. ROLE OVERVIEW Data is the foundation of AI performance, and we believe model quality starts with data quality. For speech and audio models in particular, the bar for signal fidelity, consistency, and quality control is exceptionally high. We’re seeking a Machine Learning Researcher focused on audio data quality, ML data evaluation, and quality control to lead the evaluation and optimization of large-scale speech datasets used to train audio, speech, and multimodal models. That said, we strongly prefer “skunkworks-style” teams where everyone has high ownership and broad autonomy. DOCUMENTATION & OPERATIONS - Maintain accurate, timely documentation of session notes, care plans, medication decisions, and progress updates within Brightline's electronic health record system. - Utilize Brightline's AI-assisted documentation tools — including an AI scribe — to support efficient, high-quality note completion without sacrificing clinical nuance. - Adhere to Brightline's documentation standards and turnaround expectations, supporting seamless care coordination across the team. - Partner effectively with non-clinical care operations staff on scheduling, patient communication, and care logistics. GROWTH & INNOVATION - Engage with Brightline's evolving technology stack with curiosity and adaptability, including AI tools, telehealth platforms, and clinical decision support features. - Participate in quality improvement initiatives, clinical trainings, and professional development opportunities offered by Brightline. - Contribute clinical perspective to team discussions about care model improvement, protocol development, and patient experience.
